info.title: Tachyon API
info.description:
Tachyon Knowledge Management System API

A comprehensive API for managing documents, knowledge graphs, projects, and collaborative workflows.

post.summary:
POST /auth/guest
Rate limit: 3 requests per minute per IP
Authenticate a user with username/email and password.
post.description:
`POST /auth/login`

Request body: JSON with `username` (or email), `password`.
Rate limit: 5 requests per minute per IP.
Response: 200 with `AuthenticateResponse`. Returns `mfa_required: true` if MFA is enabled.

Revokes the provided refresh token. If no refresh token is provided,
returns success (backward compatible with stateless JWT logout).

post.summary:
POST /auth/magic-link/request
Rate limit: 3 requests per minute per IP

POST /auth/magic-link/verify
Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per IP

get.summary: Get the current authenticated user's profile.
get.description:
`GET /auth/me`

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.
Response: 200 with `UserResponse`, or 401/404 on error.

put.summary: Update the current authenticated user's profile.
put.description:
`PUT /auth/me`

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.
Request body: JSON with optional `display_name`, `email`.
Response: 200 with updated `UserResponse`, or 401/409/404 on error.

post.description:
`POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/authenticate`

Accepts a TOTP code or a backup code. On success, issues access and refresh tokens.

400.description: Invalid code or MFA not setup

post.summary: Disable MFA for the authenticated user.
post.description:
`POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/disable`

Requires a valid TOTP code to confirm the action. Clears the secret and backup codes.

400.description: Invalid code or MFA not enabled

post.summary: Initiate TOTP MFA setup for the authenticated user.
post.description:
`POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/enable`

Generates a new TOTP secret, QR code URI, and 10 backup codes.
MFA is not active until the user verifies a code via the verify endpoint.

post.summary: Verify a TOTP code to complete MFA setup.
post.description:
`POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/verify`

Accepts a 6-digit TOTP code. On success, enables MFA for the user.

400.description: Invalid code or MFA not setup

get.summary:
Redirect user to GitHub's authorization page.
Generates a CSRF state nonce and includes it in the authorization URL.

Handle GitHub OAuth2 callback.
Validates the CSRF state nonce before processing the authorization code.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: CSRF state nonce — must match the value generated during the authorize step.

get.summary:
Redirect user to Google's consent screen.
Generates a CSRF state nonce and includes it in the authorization URL.

Handle Google OAuth2 callback.
Validates the CSRF state nonce before processing the authorization code.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: CSRF state nonce — must match the value generated during the authorize step.

post.summary:
POST /auth/password-reset/confirm
Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per IP

POST /auth/password-reset
Rate limit: 3 requests per minute per IP
Refresh an access token using a refresh token.
post.description:
`POST /auth/refresh`

Request body: JSON with `refresh_token`.
Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per IP.
Revokes the old refresh token and issues a new access + refresh token pair.
Response: 200 with `AuthenticateResponse`, or 401/500 on error.

`POST /auth/register`

Request body: JSON with `username` (3-50 chars), `display_name` (1-100 chars), `password` (8+ chars), optional `email`.
Rate limit: 3 requests per minute per IP.
Response: 200 with `AuthenticateResponse` (includes `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `user`), or 400/409/500 on error.

post.summary:
POST /auth/sms-otp/request
Rate limit: 3 requests per minute per IP

POST /auth/sms-otp/verify
Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per IP

get.summary: GET /api/v1/collaboration/mentions/{user_id} — Get mentions for a user
GET /api/v1/collaboration/presence/{document_id} — Get presence for a document
List documents with pagination and optional filters.
get.description:
`GET /api/v1/documents?page=&page_size=&author_id=&project_id=`

Query params: `page` (default 1), `page_size` (default 20, max 100), `author_id`, `project_id`.
Response: 200 with `DocumentSearchResponse` containing `results`, `total`, `page`, `page_size`.

post.description:
`POST /api/v1/documents`

Request body: JSON with `title` (required), `content`, `project_id`, `tags`, `visibility`.
Response: 201 with the created `DocumentResponse`, or 400/401/500 on error.

get.description:
`GET /api/v1/documents/cursor?after=&before=&limit=`

Query params: `after` (cursor from previous page's `next_cursor`),
  `before` (cursor from previous page's `prev_cursor`), `limit` (default 20, max 100).
Response: 200 with `CursorPage<DocumentResponse>`.

post.description:
`POST /api/v1/documents/render`

Request body: raw markdown string.
Response: 200 with `html`, `word_count`, `character_count`, `heading_count`, `code_block_count`, `render_time_ms`.

get.description:
`GET /api/v1/documents/search`

Requires a non-empty `search` query parameter. Supports `page` and `page_size` pagination.

`GET /api/v1/documents/{document_id}`

Authorization: The authenticated user must be the document author (owner),
or the document must have `visibility=public`. Returns 403 otherwise.

Response: 200 with `DocumentResponse`, or 400 (invalid ID) / 403 (forbidden) / 404 on error.

put.description:
`PUT /api/v1/documents/{document_id}`

Request body: JSON with optional `title`, `content`, `tags`, `visibility`, `status`.
Automatically creates a version snapshot when content changes.
Response: 200 with updated `DocumentResponse`, or 400/404/500 on error.

delete.description:
`DELETE /api/v1/documents/{document_id}`

Removes the document from the database and the Tantivy search index.
Response: 204 No Content, or 400 (invalid ID) / 404 on error.

get.description: `GET /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/attachments`

post.summary: Upload an attachment to a document.
post.description:
`POST /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/attachments`

Accepts multipart form data with a single file field.

get.description:
`GET /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/attachments/{attachment_id}`

Returns the raw file content with appropriate `Content-Type` and `Content-Disposition` headers.

get.summary: Get documents that link to the given document.
get.description:
`GET /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/backlinks`

Queries the `outgoing_links` JSONB column to find all documents referencing
this document by title. Returns up to 50 backlinks ordered by update time,
each with a short excerpt and link context showing where the link appears.

get.summary: Get conflict information for a document.
get.description:
`GET /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/conflict`

Returns whether a conflict is detected and, if so, a 3-way merge result.

post.description:
`POST /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/conflict/resolve`

Accepts a resolution strategy: `ours`, `theirs`, or `manual` (requires `content`).
Clears the conflict flag on the document.

get.summary: Get document metadata (key-value pairs) by ID.
get.description:
`GET /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/metadata`

Response: 200 with a JSON object of metadata fields, or 400/404 on error.

get.summary: List all reviews for a document.
get.description: `GET /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/reviews`

post.summary: Create a new review request for a document.
post.description:
`POST /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/reviews`

Sends a notification to the assigned reviewer and triggers a `review_created` webhook.

put.description:
`PUT /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/reviews/{review_id}`

Valid statuses: `approved`, `rejected`, `changes_requested`, `cancelled`.
Triggers a webhook event and notification on status change.

get.description:
`GET /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/versions`

Returns up to 50 most recent versions.

post.description:
`POST /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/versions`

Saves a snapshot of the document content with an optional commit message.

get.summary: Compute a line-level diff between two document versions.
get.description:
`GET /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/versions/{v1}/diff/{v2}`

Returns old/new line arrays with `added`, `removed`, or `unchanged` type annotations
and diff statistics.
`GET /api/v1/documents/{document_id}/versions/{version_number}`

`GET /api/v1/files/list?path=...&all=...`

Returns entries sorted with directories first. Supports `path` and `all` query parameters.

`GET /api/v1/files/read?path=...`

Returns JSON with content, size, encoding, and parsed YAML frontmatter for text files.
Returns raw binary content for image/PDF files.

`GET /api/v1/files/recent?limit=...`

Returns files sorted by modification time. Default limit is 20, max 100.

`GET /api/v1/files/search?query=...&path=...`

Performs a case-insensitive filename search under the specified path (defaults to root).

`GET /api/v1/files/stats`

Returns total files, directories, size, file type breakdown, and top 10 largest files.

`GET /api/v1/files/tree?path=...&depth=...`

Returns a nested tree structure. Maximum depth is 5 (defaults to 2).

post.description:
`POST /api/v1/files/upload`

Accepts multipart form data. Validates file extension and content type.
Maximum file size is 50 MB.

get.summary: Query the graph state at a specific point in time.
get.description: Returns all nodes and edges that were active at the given ISO 8601 timestamp.

get.summary: Compute the diff of the graph between two timestamps.
get.description: Returns added/removed nodes and edges between `from` and `to` timestamps.

post.summary: Query the graph: traverse neighbors or find shortest path.
post.description:
`POST /graph/query`

Request body: JSON with `source_id` (required), optional `direction` ("incoming"/"outgoing"/"both"),
`edge_type`, `depth` (default 3, max 5), `target_id` (for shortest path), `at` (point-in-time timestamp).
If `target_id` is provided, returns the shortest path between source and target.
Otherwise, returns all neighbors up to `depth` hops.
Response: 200 with `GraphQueryResponse` containing `nodes`, `edges`, `node_count`, `edge_count`.

`POST /nodes`

Request body: JSON with `name` (required), optional `node_type`, `description`, `content`, `visibility`, `weight`, `properties`, `project_id`, `document_id`, `slug`.
Response: 200 with `GraphNode`, or 400/409/500 on error.

get.summary: Get a graph node by ID.
get.description:
`GET /nodes/{node_id}`

Response: 200 with `GraphNode`, or 404 on error.

get.summary: List notifications for the current user.
get.description:
`GET /api/v1/notifications`

Supports `limit`, `offset`, and `include_read` query parameters.

post.description: `POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all`

get.description: `GET /api/v1/notifications/unread-count`

post.summary: Mark a single notification as read.
post.description: `POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read`

post.summary: Mark an onboarding step as completed.
post.description: `POST /api/v1/onboarding/complete`

`POST /api/v1/onboarding/sample-content`

Creates up to 5 sample documents (Welcome, Getting Started, Markdown Guide,
Knowledge Graph, Keyboard Shortcuts) if the user has fewer than 3 documents.

get.summary: Get the current user's onboarding status.
get.description:
`GET /api/v1/onboarding/status`

Returns which steps are completed and the current step index.

`GET /api/v1/onboarding/suggestions`

Returns suggested tags, templates, and tips for new users.

`GET /api/v1/organizations`

Uses the authenticated user's ID by default. Supports `user_id`, `include_personal`,
`limit`, and `offset` query parameters.

post.description:
`POST /api/v1/organizations`

The authenticated user becomes the organization owner.

get.summary: Get a single organization by ID.
get.description: `GET /api/v1/organizations/{id}`

put.description:
`PUT /api/v1/organizations/{id}`

Accepts partial updates for name, description, icon, logo, default role, max members, and settings.

get.description: `GET /api/v1/organizations/{org_id}/members`

post.summary: Add a member to an organization.
post.description: `POST /api/v1/organizations/{org_id}/members`

put.summary: Update a member's role in an organization.

delete.summary: Remove a member from an organization.

get.description:
`GET /api/v1/plugins`

Supports `enabled`, `runtime_type`, `limit`, and `offset` query filters.

post.description:
`POST /api/v1/plugins`

Requires `name` and `version` fields.

post.summary: POST /api/v1/plugins/invoke — Invoke a hook across all enabled plugins

get.description: `GET /api/v1/plugins/{plugin_id}`

put.description:
`PUT /api/v1/plugins/{plugin_id}`

Accepts partial updates for description, version, author, homepage, license,
extension points, manifest, entry point, and enabled state.

get.summary: List all projects with optional filters

post.summary: Add a member to a project

delete.summary: Remove a member from a project

get.description: `GET /api/v1/roles`

post.description:
`POST /api/v1/roles`

Validates that the role name is 1–50 characters.

post.summary: Seed default roles into the database.
post.description:
`POST /api/v1/roles/seed`

Creates the built-in system roles (owner, admin, editor, viewer) if they do not exist.

get.description: `GET /api/v1/roles/{role_id}`

delete.description:
`DELETE /api/v1/roles/{role_id}`

System roles and roles still assigned to users cannot be deleted.

get.summary: Full-text search across documents with faceted filtering.
get.description:
`GET /search?q=&page=&page_size=&content_type=&status=&visibility=&project_id=&author_id=&tags=&date_from=&date_to=`

Fuses results from PostgreSQL full-text search and Tantivy index.
Response: 200 with `SearchResultsResponse` containing `results`, `total`, `page`, `page_size`, `facets`.

get.summary: Get search suggestions (autocomplete) from the Tantivy index.
get.description:
`GET /search/suggest?q=&limit=`

Query params: `q` (required), `limit` (default 10).
Response: 200 with `SuggestResponse` containing `query` and `suggestions`, or 503 if index unavailable.

post.summary: Create a new session for a user.
post.description:
`POST /sessions`

Request body: JSON with `user_id` (required), optional `metadata`.
Response: 200 with `SessionResponse`, or 400/500 on error.

get.description:
`GET /sessions/{session_id}`

Response: 200 with `SessionResponse`, or 400/404/410 (expired) on error.

delete.description:
`DELETE /sessions/{session_id}`

Response: 204 No Content, or 400/404 on error.

get.summary: Validate whether a session is still active.
get.description:
`GET /sessions/{session_id}/validate`

Response: 200 with `{"valid": bool, "session_id": string}`.

`GET /spaces?owner_id=&parent_id=&visibility=&limit=&offset=`

Response: 200 with `Vec<SpaceResponse>`, or 500 on error.

post.description:
`POST /spaces`

Request body: JSON with `name` (required), optional `description`, `icon`, `color`, `parent_id`, `visibility`.
Response: 201 with `SpaceResponse`, or 400/500 on error.

get.description:
`GET /spaces/{space_id}`

Response: 200 with `SpaceResponse`, or 404 on error.

put.description:
`PUT /spaces/{space_id}`

Request body: JSON with optional `name`, `description`, `icon`, `color`, `parent_id`, `visibility`, `sort_order`.
Response: 200 with `SpaceResponse`, or 500 on error.

delete.description:
`DELETE /spaces/{space_id}`

Response: 204 No Content, or 404 on error.

post.summary: POST /api/v1/ssg/build — Generate static site as ZIP

get.summary: GET /api/v1/ssg/download — Download the generated site as ZIP
List all tags with document counts.
get.description:
`GET /api/v1/tags`

Returns up to 100 tags ordered by usage count (descending).

`GET /api/v1/teams`

Supports optional `owner_id` or `user_id` query parameters to filter results.

post.description:
`POST /api/v1/teams`

Validates the team name (1–100 characters) and slug (alphanumeric and hyphens).
The authenticated user becomes the team owner and is assigned the "owner" role.

get.description: `GET /api/v1/teams/{team_id}`

put.description:
`PUT /api/v1/teams/{team_id}`

Accepts partial updates for name, slug, and description.

get.description: `GET /api/v1/teams/{team_id}/members`

post.summary: Add a member to a team.
post.description:
`POST /api/v1/teams/{team_id}/members`

Requires a `user_id` and `role_name` in the request body.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a team.

get.description:
`GET /api/v1/templates`

Supports an optional `category` query parameter to filter results.

post.description: `POST /api/v1/templates`

get.description: `GET /api/v1/templates/{template_id}`

put.description:
`PUT /api/v1/templates/{template_id}`

Accepts partial updates for name, description, content, category, and tags.

post.summary: Create a new user (admin-only, can set role).
post.description:
Unlike `/auth/register`, this endpoint allows setting an arbitrary role
and is intended for admin use.

delete.summary: Delete a user (soft-delete: sets is_active = false).

get.summary: List all active sessions for a user.
get.description:
`GET /users/{user_id}/sessions`

Response: 200 with `SessionListResponse` containing `sessions` and `total`, or 500 on error.

delete.summary: Revoke all sessions for a user.
delete.description:
`DELETE /users/{user_id}/sessions`

Response: 200 with `{"success": true, "revoked_count": N}`, or 500 on error.

get.description: `GET /api/v1/webhooks`

post.description:
`POST /api/v1/webhooks`

Requires at least one event type in the `events` array.

mfa_required.description: Whether MFA is required to complete login

mfa_user_id.description: User ID for MFA completion (set when mfa_required is true)

excerpt.description: Short excerpt from the linking document (first 200 chars of content).

link_context.description: The surrounding text (up to 80 chars) where the wikilink appears in the linking document.

Component.description: Database model for component catalog (Backstage component)

CreateComponentRequest.description: Request to create a new component

CreateProjectRequest.description: Request to create a new project

owner_id.description:
Optional owner UUID. When auth middleware is active, this is
overridden by the authenticated user's identity. For
unauthenticated contexts (migration scripts, seeding) it allows
explicit assignment.

CreateUserRequest.description: Request to create a new user (admin-only, can set role).

Cursor.description:
An opaque pagination cursor encoding the position and sort direction.
Format: `{id}:{direction}` where direction is "asc" or "desc".

conflict_detected.description: Whether a sync conflict was detected (content changed in both file and DB)

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of raw markdown content (for integrity checking)

project_id.description: Project ID (was repository_id, renamed to match schema)

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response body returned by all API error handlers.

GraphEdge.description: Database model for knowledge graph edges

deactivated_at.description: When the edge was deactivated (None if currently active)

edge_type.description: Edge type (references, depends_on, similar_to, part_of, related_to, tagged_with)

GraphNode.description: Database model for knowledge graph nodes

deactivated_at.description: When the node was deactivated (None if currently active)

at.description:
ISO 8601 timestamp for point-in-time graph query.
If provided, only nodes/edges active at this time are returned.

owner_id.description: Owner ID (optional, for demo uses a default)

Invoice.description:
An invoice associated with a subscription.

Stores the amount in minor currency units (cents), payment URL,
and optional `paid_at` timestamp.

Notification.description: A user-facing notification stored in the `notifications` table.

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON payload tied to the notification.

read.description: Whether the user has read this notification.

title.description: Short summary shown in the UI.

OnboardingStep.description: A single step in the onboarding flow.

completed.description: Whether the user has completed this step.

PoolMetrics.description: Snapshot of the connection pool metrics.

project_type.description: Project type (service, library, website, documentation, etc.)

RefreshRequest.description: Request to refresh an access token.

RegisterRequest.description: Request to register a new user.

Space.description:
A workspace or vault for organizing documents into hierarchies.

Spaces can be nested via `parent_id` and scoped to a specific owner
or shared with members. Each space carries display metadata (icon,
color) and a JSON `settings` blob.

SsgBuildResultWrapper.description: Wrapper for BuildResult to use in JSON

Subscription.description:
An active or past subscription for an organization.

Tracks the current billing period, plan, and whether the subscription
will cancel at the end of the period.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Request to update the current user's own profile.

UsageMetrics.description: Usage metrics for the billing period

UserRecord.description:
Database row model for the `users` table.

This maps 1:1 to the PostgreSQL `users` schema. Conversion to/from
`tachyon_core::types::user::User` is provided via `From` impls.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI.

is_active.description: Whether the account is currently active.

totp_enabled.description: Whether time-based one-time password 2FA is enabled.

totp_secret.description: Base32-encoded TOTP secret (present when 2FA is configured).

totp_verified_at.description: When the user last verified their TOTP setup.
